title: Assemble saved feedback and writing reports independently

dependency_checks: Verify school identity, private destination, frozen exact saved-report selection and sole actual writer; never package a document currently being edited.
Use exact saved verified report versions with known source/review chronology; whole-class completeness is not inferred from latest-available saved reports.
This independent operation requires no generation/model capability, Hub health, email outbox or live IC read; do not relax generation gates to assemble saved reports.
Preserve prior packets and student files. Reopen the entire saved PDF, verify its hash, page order, readability, manifest and private destination before publishing the link.
Turn only included matching report versions white after complete packet readback; newer versions stay yellow, and interrupted or failed builds never clear readiness.
Keep explicit omitted/held scopes and actual original dates; report selection is latest verified coverage, not all latest submissions assessed.
Update the same spreadsheet with exact PDF/version inclusion and native readback; Hub-link publication can follow independently without blocking that saved result.
No physical print, email send, IC write, grade verification inference or teacher Printed/Handed mutation follows from packet inclusion.

success_checks: One saved readable PDF is linked in the existing spreadsheet with exact included report versions, page ranges/hash and explicit omitted coverage.
Only exact included versions receive verified packet status; newer/unincluded versions retain yellow and unavailable work remains explicit.
An unchanged rerun reuses the exact packet without duplicate assessment, filing or changes to IC/Printed/Handed status.
